title: REQ · Blank or whitespace-only submit is blocked with 'Enter an idea first'
summary: Pressing Send with blank text shows an inline alert and makes no API call
description: Context: handleSubmit trims the text and silently returns when empty. Desired behavior: set a validation message 'Enter an idea first', render it inline under the textarea with role=alert, link it with aria-describedby and mark the textarea aria-invalid. Expected result: submitContribution is never called for blank text. Why: silent failure confuses players.
acceptance_criteria: Given an empty textarea, when the form is submitted, then an element with role=alert has the text 'Enter an idea first'
Given text of only spaces and newlines, when the form is submitted, then the same alert appears and submitContribution is not called
Given the alert is shown, then the textarea has aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby pointing to the alert id

in_scope: Validation state, blank branch and inline message in ContributionSheet
preserve: Server error alert rendered from error state

technical_constraints: Keep the message separate from server `error` state so it can clear independently
definition_of_done: No API call for blank submit
